mapper.insert: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.PostMapper.insert */ INSERT INTO POST ( TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, HITS, INSERT_DATE, INSERT_ID ) VALUES ( #{postType}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), #{loginId} )
